newsitem.title: FRANCE: Man shoots two people, takes 35 hostage in Paris.
newsitem.headline: Man shoots two people, takes 35 hostage in Paris.

text.p: An armed man shot and wounded two people when he took 35 people hostage in central Paris on Friday, police said.
A police spokesman said the man had taken the group hostage on the third floor of a building on Boulevard Haussmann near the Galeries Lafayette department store.
"The man is holding 35 people hostage. He has shot two people, apparently with a hunting rifle. It's not politically motivated," the spokesman said. The two injured were taken to hospital.
Police sources said the man was 55 years old and had a grievance against his former employer, the ADC security delivery firm.
The avenue was cordoned off and police and emergency services were called to the scene.
